name: lan-airdrop
description: High-performance direct browser-to-browser WebRTC file transfer with QR mobile pairing and zero server storage.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const isWin = process.platform === 'win32'; const npmCmd = isWin ? 'npm.cmd' : 'npm'; const s = spawn(npmCmd, ['start'], { cwd: './server', stdio: 'inherit' }); const c = spawn(npmCmd, ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: './client', stdio: 'inherit' }); process.on('SIGINT', () => { s.kill(); c.kill(); process.exit(); });"

author: LAN Airdrop Team
